meta.title: Fairy III · Zenless Zone Zero H.D.D skin
meta.description: A Zenless Zone Zero H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: boot animation, animated eye core with a usage bubble, time-of-day greeting, automatic light/dark switching with a contrast check, the 绳匠满级之路 study-todo card in the sidebar (toggle under Settings → Fairy), a per-session Fairy toolchain switch that trims the tool schemas each request carries, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice — the analysis is read when it finishes, a ~100-character summary after the reply lands, and URLs / paths / English are never spoken.
